title: Does Learning Protein Folding Generalize to Broader Reasoning?
abstract: arXiv:2609.38879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models rely heavily on human text, which often conveys surface answers rather than the spatial and structural logic behind them. Protein folding is a natural testbed, because one solved structure yields thousands of exactly checkable spatial and topological statements. We ask: can learning to fold proteins teach general models reusable reasoning capabilities? To answer this, we build FoldingCorpus, a protein-derived question-answer dataset, and Fold2Reason, a recipe that post-trains on it through two complementary signals: discrete structural answers predicted via the model's native language head, and continuous 3D geometry decoded from the same shared representations. On FoldBench, Fold2Reason achieves structure prediction scores 2.7 to 3.5 times those of Qwen3.5-9B. translated_title: 学习蛋白质折叠能否泛化到更广泛的推理？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型严重依赖人类文本，而人类文本往往只传达表面答案，而非其背后蕴含的空间与结构逻辑。蛋白质折叠是一个天然的测试平台，因为一个已解析的结构可以产生数千条可精确验证的空间和拓扑陈述。我们提出这样一个问题：学习蛋白质折叠能否教会通用模型可复用的推理能力？为回答这一问题，我们构建了FoldingCorpus——一个源自蛋白质的问答数据集，并提出Fold2Reason——一种基于该数据集进行后训练的方法，其通过两种互补信号进行训练：一种是通过模型原生语言头预测的离散结构答案，另一种是从相同共享表示中解码的连续三维几何信息。在FoldBench上，Fold2Reason取得的结构预测分数达到Qwen3.5-9B的2.7至3.5倍。除了蛋白质结构预测之外，它在涵盖空间、图、科学和通用推理的全部10个基准测试上均提升了性能，并提高了宏观……
tldr: 本文提出Fold2Reason方法，通过源自蛋白质折叠的数据集对大语言模型进行后训练，不仅将结构预测分数提升至基线的2.7-3.5倍，还成功将学到的空间结构推理能力泛化到空间、图、科学和通用推理等更广泛的任务中。
en_tdlr: Fold2Reason post-trains LLMs on a protein folding-derived QA dataset using both discrete structural answers and continuous 3D geometry signals, achieving 2.7-3.5x structure prediction scores over Qwen3.5-9B while generalizing to all 10 spatial, graph, scientific, and general reasoning benchmarks.
